text:
mai: Ran initial onboard smoke for zenKai-v1-compact (q4a, int8 fallback). Results weird on JP vertical + Arabic-mixed inputs — BLEU down ~6 pts vs float baseline. Anyone seen this pattern before?
rohan: Can you paste the eval command + a failing sample?
jess: Also which dataset split? small vs full?
mai: Eval command: ```python tools/eval_multilang.py --model zenKai-v1-compact --quant q4a --dataset datasets/multilingual/vertical-mix-1k --split smoke --metrics bleu chrf sacrebleu --seed 42 --commit abc1234```
mai: Quick note: chrF down ~0.08 too, not just BLEU.
jess: Upload the outputs? looks like a detok step might be stripping ruby/furigana markers on quant path.
mai: Uploading diffs now. Observed example: float -> "東京<ruby>とうきょう</ruby>駅" whereas q4a output -> "東京駅" (reading lost). baseline retained reading in some cases.
akiko: If the ruby tag is dropped that could be a tokenizer/norm issue or our detok pipeline. Did the tokenizer change between builds? q4a build sometimes points at fast-tokenizer-v2.
li: Did a quick token-count: float tokens=18, q4a tokens=16. Also saw a mirrored bracket flip in Arabic sample — closing bracket appears on wrong side after detok. Could be bidi reorder + whitespace fold interaction.
jess: BLEU drop seems concentrated on vertical corpora (subtitle/ocr style). Maybe newline normalization or vertical-space normalization is different in quant pipeline.
mai: Bisecting commits between abc1000..abc1234. Early suspect: abc1100 toggled `treat_ruby` config false. Running int8 build with old tokenizer pinned.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: zenKai-v1-compact-q4a (canary id c-314) on staging.
rohan: If pinning restores parity we should pin tokenizer in model config and add unit tests for ruby roundtrip and bidi brackets.
akiko: I'll add tests: 1) ruby roundtrip, 2) bidi bracket mirror, 3) vertical-newline preserve. Also check compile kernels for any whitespace folding optimizations for vertical scripts.
mai: Plan: 1) repro + small 200-sample set with examples attached, 2) pin tokenizer in quant build, 3) rebuild q4a, 4) shadow int8 on 500-sample regression set, 5) measure BLEU/chrF deltas. ETA EOD.
jess: :thumbsup: Please paste the diff link when ready.
mai: attaching repro gist and short script in the issue after build completes. Will update here.
